verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only pay-as-you-go, no-commitment access for Spot and On-Demand capacity, plus billing-insights usage breakdowns. Nothing documents billing granularity (per-second or per-minute) or states that charges accrue only while an instance is running. Pay-as-you-go describes the commitment model, not metering granularity, so it is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I am billed at per-second or per-minute granularity and only while my instance is actually running

citations.quote: Spot Node Pools provide pay-as-you-go access to high-performance bare-metal compute resources without long-term commitments or reservations.
